# S01 independent implementation and extraction-fidelity audit

Date: 2026-09-14. Reviewed HEAD: `8e9e315dcee3642bbc0d4b2422421dc1aedfb26e`.
Reviewer: independent Codex content-review agent; no implementation authorship.
Pinned corpus: `vendor/steel-compendium` at
`fb83a789da8f0327a389c277a0c790b1648d5810` (`v4.20260908021459`).
The working tree was clean at review start. No deployment, seed, commit, or STATUS update was performed.

- **Independent implementation review: changes required.** S01-F1 loses structured content in the
  application mirror; S01-F2 leaves acceptance check 1 unsatisfied.
- **Rules extraction review: pass for the checked-in 403-entry snapshot at this HEAD.** Every extracted
  value matches the pinned source, including all Goblin Warrior fields and all 15 Fury level-one abilities.
  The application delivery omission in S01-F1 still prevents approval of the complete slice.
  This is extraction fidelity, not approval of ability execution, build eligibility, or rules automation.

## Findings

### S01-F1 — P2: Convex mirror discards the stat block's structured features

`convex/content.ts:127` inserts only the frontmatter projection, and `convex/contentTables.ts:8`
has neither `features` nor `jsonPath`. The return validator at `convex/content.ts:11` and projection
at `convex/content.ts:29` also omit them. `convex/foes.ts:17` consequently snapshots only that reduced
record. Generated `shared/content/compendium/statblock.json` has three features copied from the JSON
twin: Spear Charge, Bury the Point, and Crafty. After reseeding, shared operations and foe snapshots
cannot retrieve those structured ability/trait records or their JSON provenance, despite the source
contract in `shared/contracts/content.ts:39` and the mirror description in `shared/content/README.md`.
The full Markdown survives, so this is a structured-data omission, not lost readable rules text.

Required fix: preserve `jsonPath` and optional `features` through the schema, reseed, full-entry query,
and foe snapshot. Add a persisted-read assertion against the vendor JSON twin for all three features.
The existing content test asserts only text and selected stat fields and therefore passes with this loss.

### S01-F2 — P2: hand-edited generation dates evade content validation

`scripts/build-content.ts:366` trusts `previous.generatedAt` whenever the content hash agrees and
its shape matches a date regex. A changed date is therefore treated as the expected generated value.
The read-only reproduction below prints `9999-99-99`, demonstrating that even an impossible date is
accepted. This contradicts S01 acceptance check 1 and the README promise of detecting any generated
file edit; the slice work log acknowledges the limitation but does not revise acceptance.

```bash
node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
import { buildSnapshot, readCommittedManifest } from './scripts/build-content.ts';
const previous = readCommittedManifest();
previous.generatedAt = '9999-99-99';
console.log(buildSnapshot(undefined, previous).manifest.generatedAt);
JS
```

Required fix: derive/check this metadata independently of the generated file, or explicitly resolve
the acceptance contract to allow an intentionally editable date and validate real dates. Do not
represent the current check as detecting every hand edit. Ordinary entry edits are detected.

## Independent source comparison and random sample

A fresh sample was selected without using the implementer's test sampler: rank the 403 IDs by
`SHA256(UTF8("20260914-S01-independent:" + id))` ascending and take the first ten. The table presents
that set in source-path order. For every sample, the complete UTF-8 Markdown bytes match the vendor
file, `name`/`id`/`kind` match `name`/`scc`/`type`, and the **entire** structured object matches the
frontmatter parsed independently by installed PyYAML 6.0. This catches missing keys and swapped values,
which the implementer's `frontmatterStates` substring checks alone would not establish. Paths,
selection membership, and optional features were also checked. The same complete checks were then
run across all 403 entries, with no differences.

All paths below are relative to `vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/`.

| Sample source | All structured keys checked | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `skill/crafting/tailoring.md` | (none) | exact match |
| `feature/fury/vuken/aspect-benefits.md` | `class`, `kit` | exact match |
| `skill/intrigue/search.md` | (none) | exact match |
| `complication/misunderstood.md` | `flavor` | exact match |
| `condition/slowed.md` | (none) | exact match |
| `condition/frightened.md` | (none) | exact match |
| `career/disciple.md` | `flavor`, `perk`, `project_points`, `skills` | exact match |
| `feature/fury/boren/primordial-storm-blizzard.md` | `class`, `kit` | exact match |
| `feature/common/maneuvers/knockback.md` | (none) | exact match |
| `career/gladiator.md` | `flavor`, `language`, `perk`, `renown`, `skills` | exact match |

Reproduction from repository root (uses an independent YAML parser; does not import the generator):

```python
import hashlib, json, pathlib, yaml
root = pathlib.Path('.')
directory = root / 'shared/content/compendium'
manifest = json.loads((directory / 'manifest.json').read_text())
entries = [e for p in sorted(directory.glob('*.json')) if p.name != 'manifest.json'
           for e in json.loads(p.read_text())]
sample = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: hashlib.sha256(
    ('20260914-S01-independent:' + e['id']).encode()).hexdigest())[:10]
print('Sample:', [e['id'] for e in sample])
for e in entries:
    raw = (root / e['sourcePath']).read_bytes()
    assert e['text'].encode() == raw, e['id']
    fields = yaml.safe_load(raw.decode().split('---\n', 2)[1])
    assert (e['id'], e['kind'], e['name']) == (
        fields['scc'], fields['type'], fields['name'])
    expected = {k: x for k, x in fields.items() if k not in ('scc', 'type', 'name')}
    assert json.dumps(e['structured'], sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(expected, sort_keys=True)
    twin = json.loads((root / e['jsonPath']).read_text())
    expected_features = twin.get('features') if e['kind'] == 'statblock' else None
    assert e.get('features') == (expected_features or None)
    relative = e['sourcePath'].removeprefix('vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/')
    assert any(s['id'] == e['selection'] and any(
        relative == p or relative.startswith(p + '/') for p in s['paths'])
        for s in manifest['selections'])
print('Verified:', len(entries))
```

  `might` 10; `movement` 11; `name` 12; `organization` 13; `presence` 14; `reason` 15;
  `role` 16; `scc` 17; `size` 18; `speed` 19; `stability` 20; `stamina` 21; `type` 22.
- `ev` and `stamina` remain strings; numeric characteristics remain numbers. No immunity,
  weakness, cost, or other absent field is invented from a dash in the printed table.

The attached `features` equals the entire array in

Every nested field was compared, with the following source-line map:

| Bury the Point | `cost` 30; `distance` 31; `effects[0].roll` 34; `tier1` 35; `tier2` 36; `tier3` 37; `feature_type` 40; `icon` 41; `keywords` 42–46; `name` 47; `target` 48; `type` 49; `usage` 50 | name/cost/icon 43; keywords/action 45; distance/target 47; roll 49; tiers 51–53 |

## Inferred-default search and scope

Reviewed the generator's destructuring/copy path and recursively inspected scalar leaves of every
`structured` object and the stat-block `features` array for zero, null, `none`, or `unknown` defaults.
The only zero-valued structured leaves are Goblin Warrior `intuition`, `reason`, and `stability`,
explicitly printed on Markdown lines 5, 15, and 20. There are no null, `none`, or `unknown` structured
leaves and no such feature leaves. Empty ability keyword arrays are explicit source `keywords: []`,
for example Furious Change line 11 and Make Peace With Your God! line 10. The snapshot has no inferred
zero-cost fields. Generator bookkeeping defaults (empty arrays, optional tag null) are not game facts.

All included IDs have core sourcebook prefixes. The 10 exclusions are the eight Beastheart perks and
the two known supplemental unified chapter paths. The clean pinned corpus is the only rules source
used. The manifest openly records the missing language entries and omitted chapter context; therefore
this review does not certify complete R01 input coverage or complete chapter/reference closure.
Kit inclusion also does not certify eligibility for any particular Fury aspect.

  auth rejection, foe behavior, and generated-file difference detection.
- Independent PyYAML comparison: **403/403 exact**, plus the ten reproducible samples and complete
  Goblin/Fury field tracing above. The snapshot is not validated merely by regenerating it with its
  own parser.
- Generation-date read-only reproduction: **confirmed acceptance failure**, prints `9999-99-99`.
- Code review confirmed public content queries authenticate, content lookups use indexes, and reseed

- No live Convex mutation/seed, browser walkthrough, deployment, or full project test suite was run by

  Passing tests do not close S01-F1 or S01-F2. Subsequent implementation changes need renewed review.
